messages:
maria_cs: Hey - customer OrbisAI flagged that their invoice total for Feb is ~15.2k tokens but dashboard shows ~12.5k. Customer is on Starter plan (tier boundary behavior) and this is a month-end spike. Can someone sanity-check?
ben-eng: looking. can you paste the account id & invoice id?
maria_cs: acct_orbis_001, invoice INV-2026-02-78. dashboard snapshot attached in their message (screenshot). they say the extra lines appear under 'generation' tokens on invoice only. dashboard shows generation + embeddings breakdown that doesn't sum to invoice.
sofia_finance: I pulled INV-2026-02-78 — invoice lines show: Gen tokens 15,200; Embeds 0; Plan credit applied. Dashboard export (CSV) we have Gen tokens 12,540; Embeds 0.
alyssa_ops: did the customer migrate plans mid-period? that can flip tier arithmetic and proration.
maria_cs: they did not migrate. started feb 1 and stayed in Starter.
ben-eng: can we repro via metering pipeline? suspicious of retry double-counting window we saw last month. quick check query:```sql
-- tokens aggregated by event, missing retry filter
select acct_id, event_type, sum(tokens) as total_tokens
from metering.events
where acct_id = 'acct_orbis_001' and ts >= '2026-02-01' and ts < '2026-03-01'
group by acct_id, event_type;
```
ben-eng: compare with this filtered version:```sql
select acct_id, event_type, sum(tokens) as total_tokens
from metering.events
where acct_id = 'acct_orbis_001' and ts >= '2026-02-01' and ts < '2026-03-01'
and event_type != 'server_retry' -- exclude retries
group by acct_id, event_type;
```
ben-eng: early glance: unfiltered 15,180 gen tokens, filtered 12,560. that matches the dashboard vs invoice gap.
sofia_finance: invoice bot should be filtering retries. billing-bot, did the billing pipeline include server_retry events for Feb?
billing-bot: auto: billing pipeline run for 2026-02 completed. meter-join used "events" table v4. No retry exclusion flag was set due to missing config in v4 -> default include.
alyssa_ops: ok that explains it. why didn't the dashboard exclude retries though?
ben-eng: dashboard uses aggregated summary table (metering.rollups) which has been applying retry dedupe since Jan -> that's why dashboard shows the lower number. billing pipeline reverted to reading raw events in v4 rollout, so it didn't benefit from dedupe.
maria_cs: action items? customer is upset about unexpected charge.
sofia_finance: we'll propose a temporary credit while we confirm root cause + fix. need exact delta and policy approval.
ben-eng: plan: 1) quick fix: update billing join to apply event_type != 'server_retry' and re-run invoice regen for affected invoices (low risk). 2) longer: make v4 pipeline apply same dedupe logic and add a unit test to prevent regressions.
sofia_finance: what's the delta for OrbisAI? we need final number to compute credit.
ben-eng: delta = invoice_gen - dashboard_gen = 15,180 - 12,560 = 2,620 gen tokens.
maria_cs: please confirm and I'll offer a provisional credit for 2,620 token-equivalent and escalate to legal if they push.
ben-eng: confirmation: I ran the corrected query and simulated invoice regen locally — corrected invoice would subtract 2,620 tokens.
sofia_finance: approved to issue credit for 2,620 tokens (manual credit line). I'll file an internal billing adjustment record and notify acct team.
alyssa_ops: for visibility, I'll create an ops postmortem stub and tag eng-runtime + metering owners. Also adding a cron check that compares billing totals vs dashboard rollups for top-50 accounts on day+1 of month.
maria_cs: thanks all. I'll reply to customer with provisional credit and ETA ~48h. cc @sofia_finance @ben-eng. :thumbsup:
invoicebot: auto: support ticket #SUP-2026-442 created for OrbisAI.
ben-eng: note for followup: attach this SQL diff + test case to the PR. also schedule a replay window check for other invoices in Feb where pipeline v4 was used.
sofia_finance: will prepare a short ledger note for accounting.
maria_cs: closing loop: customer replied "thanks, appreciate the quick look". I'll keep thread open until regen + credit posted. :white_check_mark:
